# Humanos

> Humanos is the Risk Network for AI agents. It helps companies measure AI agent risk, prove safety, and unlock financial products such as insurance and credit through continuous Risk Intelligence. Measure risk. Prove safety.

Humanos provides a continuous Risk Score based on how AI agents actually operate, enabling enterprises, insurers, auditors and compliance teams to understand and manage AI risk in production.

Last updated: 2026-09-14

## The core question Humanos answers

How risky is an AI agent, and can you prove it? Humanos answers that question continuously, with a real-time Risk Score, and produces the Risk Intelligence that insurers, auditors and regulators need to underwrite, certify and trust AI in production.

---

## The problem

- Every AI agent operating in production carries risk — financial, operational, regulatory, reputational.
- Today, companies cannot measure that risk continuously, cannot prove their AI is safe, and cannot access financial products like insurance and credit for their AI systems.
- Without standardized, verifiable Risk Intelligence, AI deployments remain uninsurable, uncertifiable, and commercially limited.

---

## The solution

- Humanos continuously measures the risk of AI agents based on how they actually operate — not self-reported questionnaires.
- A real-time Risk Score gives enterprises, insurers and partners a single, verifiable measure of AI safety.
- Risk Intelligence — continuous, standardized, verifiable — unlocks insurance, credit and financial products that were previously unavailable for AI systems.

---

## Who uses Humanos

Enterprises running AI agents in production, and the financial ecosystem around them:

- Enterprises measuring and managing AI risk
- Insurers underwriting AI systems
- Auditors and compliance teams certifying AI safety
- Financial institutions extending credit to AI-powered businesses
- Regulated industries (healthcare, finance, commerce) deploying AI agents

---

## Pricing

- **Free** — $0 forever. Full risk monitoring and scoring for your first agents.
- **Pay-as-you-go** — usage-based pricing for risk scoring and Risk Intelligence at scale.
- **Enterprise** — custom pricing for regulated environments, advanced compliance needs, and volume.

See the full pricing page at https://humanos.tech/pricing.

---

## Security and data handling

- EU-hosted: primary data storage in AWS eu-west-3 (Paris).
- Certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022.
- Encryption in transit: TLS 1.2+ on all connections.
- Encryption at rest: AES-256 across primary data stores.
- GDPR-compliant; operated by Humanos Labs Inc. (Portugal). Full detail at https://humanos.tech/legal/privacy.
